# Appendix B: Related Resources

The resources below are drawn from across the Blueprint and related working group discussions. They are grouped by theme, with the resource title hyperlinked to its primary URL. Entries with no confirmed URL in the source material are shown in bold without a link, with this noted in the description.

**Persistent Identifiers and Identifier Frameworks**

| **Resource**                                                                                           | **Description and source section**                                                                              |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| [DataCite](https://datacite.org/)                                                                      | Primary membership model for institutional DOI minting for deposited datasets.                                  |
| [FAIRsharing identifier schema catalogue](https://fairsharing.org/search?fairsharingRegistry=Standard) | Catalogues identifier schemas by persistence, resolvability and global uniqueness per the EOSC PID definition.  |
| [EOSC PID definition](https://data.europa.eu/doi/10.2777/926037)                                       | Community-agreed definition of persistent identifier properties referenced in the Blueprint's PID requirements. |
| [W3C Decentralised Identifiers (DID) v1.1](https://www.w3.org/TR/did-1.1/)                             | Standard for decentralised identifiers, proposed as a basis for both dataset and agent identity.                |
| [ORCID](https://orcid.org/)                                                                            | Persistent identifier for researchers; identified as a linking target for related research outputs.             |
| [ROR (Research Organisation Registry)](https://ror.org/)                                               | Persistent identifier for research organisations; identified as a linking target for related research outputs.  |

**Repository and Standards Registries**

| **Resource**                                                        | **Description and source section**                                                                                                    |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| [FAIRsharing](https://fairsharing.org/)                             | Curated registry of community-defined standards, databases, policies, identifier schemas and reporting guidelines across disciplines. |
| [FAIRsharing MCP server](https://mcp.fairsharing.org/)              | MCP server enabling direct integration of FAIRsharing with the Data Director.                                                         |
| [re3data](https://www.re3data.org/)                                 | Registry of research data repositories with filtering by subject, access type and deposit conditions.                                 |
| [Cornell Data Storage Finder](https://finder.research.cornell.edu/) | Open-source tool for localised repository and storage recommendations; suggested as a possible reference implementation.              |
| [CoreTrustSeal](https://www.coretrustseal.org/)                     | Repository certification and trustworthiness scheme; free certification options should be prioritised over paid alternatives.         |

| **Resource**                                                                                                            | **Description and source section**                                                                                                                                                             |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| [RDA kernel metadata recommendations](https://doi.org/10.15497/RDA00031)                                                | Defines essential domain-agnostic metadata fields.                                                                                                                                             |

| [AgroPortal](https://agroportal.lirmm.fr/)                                                                              | Domain-specific ontology repository (agronomy).                                                                                                                                                |
| [RO-Crate validator](https://rocrate-validator.readthedocs.io/en/stable/)                                               | Schema validation tool for metadata quality checks.                                                                                                                                            |
| [Frictionless Data](https://frictionlessdata.io/)                                                                       | Schema validation tool for metadata quality checks.                                                                                                                                            |
| [JSON Schema](https://json-schema.org/)                                                                                 | Schema validation standard applicable to metadata validation.                                                                                                                                  |
| [XSD (XML Schema Definition)](https://hackolade.com/help/XSDXMLSchemaDefinition.html)                                   | XML schema validation reference.                                                                                                                                                               |
| [SHACL (Shapes Constraint Language)](https://www.w3.org/TR/shacl/)                                                      | Schema validation tool for metadata quality checks.                                                                                                                                            |
| [Croissant Validator / Croissant ML](https://huggingface.co/spaces/luisoala/croissant-checker)                          | Mature, generic metadata format and validator with an active community; proposed as a pilot format, supported by Croissant Baker and Croissant Miner.                                          |
| [CEDAR Workbench](https://metadatacenter.org/)                                                                          | Metadata creation and validation tool.                                                                                                                                                         |
| [Skosmos](https://skosmos.org/)                                                                                         | Vocabulary publishing and validation tool.                                                                                                                                                     |
| [FOOPS!](https://catalogue.fair-impact.eu/resources/foops)                                                              | Ontology pitfall scanner for vocabulary validation.                                                                                                                                            |
| [PROV-O](https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/)                                                                                 | Candidate standard for provenance recording with archiving option, identified for tracking AI agent actions and Full Traceability.                                                             |
| [eScience 2025 provenance paper](https://doi.org/10.1109/eScience65000.2025.00093)                                      | Community reference for PROV-O implementation in agentic AI research workflows.                                                                                                                |
| [ODRL (Open Digital Rights Language)](https://www.w3.org/TR/odrl-model/)                                                | Policy expression language referenced for machine-readable governance policies; proposed as a FAIR object with identifiers. Demo: [odrl.dev.codata.org/demo](http://odrl.dev.codata.org/demo). |
| [FAIR Digital Object (FDO) framework](https://fairdo.org/)                                                              | Supports interoperability through typed, validated objects, enabling metadata at domain-agnostic, domain-specific and application-specific levels simultaneously.                              |
| [Cross-Domain Interoperability Framework (CDIF)](https://worldfair-project.eu/cross-domain-interoperability-framework/) | Supports cross-domain metadata mapping; relevant to interoperability requirements.                                                                                                             |
